Damage returns ignored. Cooldowns decrement later that tick. onClimbable is parent OR horizontal collision and draggedClimable. contracts.actual_behavior: Winch delegates incoming original source/amount to linked head when winch is not invulnerable and head exists/not invulnerable; only successful head hurt assigns noLatchCooldown60+rand60 and returns head result; otherwise uses parent hurt. Server link/chain tick pulls head when distance>latched(1.25+sin(tick*.1F)*.25) or unlatched3.5 and not stopPullingUp. Normalize only vector length>1; disRem=min(distance-distanceGoal,1), pull speed target?.3F:.1F, head velocity=old*(.95F,.7F,.95F)+vector*disRem*speed. Blocked LOS and distance>7 admits head noPhysics only when pulling not stopped. draggedClimable is separate, raw stopGravity has no reader. Latched own noGravity true, velocity=(old+(0,.14,0))*.85F, lost ceiling/alive/cooldown gate changes state after counter>5. Unlatched returns own gravity, proximity<2.9 or upper collision and no cooldown admits latch after>5; rising writes Y1.5, start only grounded alive cooldown0 rand30==0 and overhead block. Melee goal derives head target, pursues its ceiling when latched, otherwise retreats and sets scared. Missing head server removes KILLED. hurt/death timers mirror head. Save key BodyUUID differs from read HeadUUID; preserve native mismatch.

contracts.actual_behavior: Goal admits non-null target (no own live test), detonates distance<=2; timer>300 resets eye/target/last hurt state. Exploding progress+.5F to10; at>=10 KILLED removal followed by own MineExplosion(radius5) explode then finalize(true), with no explicit side gate around that outer branch. Block mode comes from loader canEntityGrief and native mob explosion drop decay. MineExplosion emits EXPLODE game event, boundary rays16³, strength radius*(.7F+rand*.6F), march .3, decay .22500001F, ignores resistance for nonempty fluid, stops at bounds/UNMOVEABLE. Native entity bbox uses f2=radius*2; ignores source and ignoreExplosion(null), within normalized radius<=1/nonzero direction: density d10=(1-normalized distance)*seen percent, damage float(int((d10²+d10)/2*7*f2+1)). Hurt return discarded; unconditional delta += normalized direction*d10. Own named dampener simply returns input (no Blast Protection or knockback resistance). No allied/team test. Finalization drops/removes fluid-empty affected blocks, retaining fluid blocks; no vanilla Explosion object/onExplosionHit callback or Forge detonation hook is invented. Native DamageSources.explosion(direct source, causing source) identities preserved; Guardian is both for this caller. Stored damage calculator is not consulted by explode. Constructor underwaterSound argument is not assigned, so supplied water boolean is a default/reporting artifact for actual sound, not an independent runtime value. Scan/sleep/eye native state uses range8 clip, endpoint bbox inflated3, player-only validity plus both allied directions/LOS; scan every5 when progress5, max100+rand100; sleep200+rand100 and native hurt/target/water predicates. Anchor and reputation callbacks remain separate.
